_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Heterogeneous III-V-on-SOI PIC transmitter for FiWi mmWave and FSO ISAC. Achieves 24 Gbps and high-resolution ranging.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Chip cross-section and layout. Fig 2: Setup (FSO 1m, mmWave). Fig 3: Results (Constellations, Spectrograms). Text confirms 24 Gbps and 0.03m resolution.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Hybrid FiWi (mmWave) + FSO. Hardware: III-V-on-SOI PIC (Laser + EAM). Signal: ARoF (Analog Radio over Fiber) carrying 16-QAM and LFMCW.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 24 Gbps (peak capacity). EVM ~12%. Sensing: Range resolution 0.03 m (at 384m dynamic range). Experimental sensing test at 20m.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Highly integrated solution (PIC) reducing SWaP. Demonstrates operation across FR1/FR2/FR3. Joint ISAC via FDM (Sensing at 25G, Comm at 28G).
